sources.title: Qwen3.7: The Agent Frontier
sources.evidence: Official May 20, 2026 launch describes Qwen3.7-Max as proprietary and available through Model Studio, with coding, office automation, tool use and long-running agent capabilities. Read through the search-indexed article; direct browser extraction returned an empty page. No exact-model parameter counts or internal architecture specification were disclosed in the retrieved article.

sources.title: qwen3.7-max Model Info
sources.evidence: Exact alias is functionally equivalent to qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20. Documents text input/output, function calling, 1,000,000-token context and thinking-mode limits. Separately identifies June 8 snapshot as adding image/video understanding. Full HTML was fetched and inspected after the international console documentation exceeded the browser extraction limit.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Exact qwen3.7-max alias and May 20 snapshot have explicit May 20, 2026 release rows in Global scope under US (Virginia), Hong Kong (China), and Germany (Frankfurt). China (Beijing), Singapore International, and Japan Global list May 21. The May 17 snapshot belongs to the separate preview entry. Regional headings and matching rows were inspected in the full HTML.

sources.title: Qwen3.7: The Agent Frontier — official README
sources.evidence: Exact-model README confirms coding, productivity, cross-framework agent integration, sustained reasoning and tool-use positioning. Full raw README was inspected; it does not specify total/active parameters or an internal model architecture.

sources.title: Alibaba Unveils New AI Chip, Flagship Model, and Rebuilt Cloud Stack AI for Agentic Era
sources.evidence: May 20, 2026 corporate announcement identifies Qwen3.7-Max as Alibaba's new language model for sustained agent tasks.

name.note: Normalized display spelling of the official Qwen3.7-Max name.

developer.note: Alibaba's corporate announcement explicitly identifies the model as its own.

family.note: Official documentation places this exact model in the Qwen3.7 series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit exact-alias release is May 20 in Global scope in Virginia, Hong Kong and Frankfurt. May 21 is the China/Singapore rollout; May 17 is a different preview snapshot.

open_weights.note: The exact-model launch explicitly calls it proprietary.

license.note: Proprietary hosted model; no downloadable-weight license is supplied. API service terms are not an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count appears in the exact-model launch, API specification or official README reviewed. Counts from other Max generations are not evidence for this model.

active_parameters_b.note: No activated-parameter count is supplied for this proprietary model; no inferred equality or family-based estimate is used.

architecture.note: Reviewed primary documents do not specify dense/MoE or attention architecture. Agent training and kernel-optimization descriptions do not establish the model's internal architecture.

context_window.note: Explicit context-window limit in tokens, distinct from the smaller maximum input allowance.

modalities.note: Exact alias remains text-only. Vision belongs to the separately named June 8 snapshot.

reasoning.note: The alias specification includes thinking-mode and chain-of-thought limits.

tool_call.note: Function Calling is explicitly supported for the exact alias.

description.value: Text-only Qwen3.7 model for coding and agent tasks, with a one-million-token context window, thinking mode, and function calling.
description.note: Neutral description of documented capabilities; omits developer positioning as frontier.

patch.notes: Qwen3.7-Max is proprietary; total/active parameter counts and internal architecture are not disclosed in the reviewed exact-model primary documents. The qwen3.7-max alias is documented as equivalent to the text-only May 20 snapshot; the separate June 8 snapshot adds vision. Earliest explicit regional release is May 20, 2026 in Global scope in Virginia, Hong Kong and Frankfurt; China and Singapore list May 21.
patch.description: Text-only Qwen3.7 model for coding and agent tasks, with a one-million-token context window, thinking mode, and function calling.

summary: Correct release date from May 21 to the explicitly documented May 20 Global release. Confirm the text-only 1M-context alias, reasoning and tool calling. Keep total parameters, active parameters and architecture null as undisclosed; do not import details from other Max generations or the later vision snapshot.
